description: MMIR.ai chat flow. Static frontend guidance only.

stages.title: Connect
stages.description: Connect a local node, compatible backend or protected provider path.

stages.title: Detect node
stages.description: Check health and show whether the node is online, degraded or offline.

stages.title: List models
stages.description: Load available models and populate the model selector from the live backend.

stages.title: Add context
stages.description: Attach files, knowledge sources or project context before sending work to a model.

stages.title: Assign roles
stages.description: Apply role presets such as architect, critic, coder, researcher or synthesizer.

stages.title: Send
stages.description: Send the normalized request to the selected connector or backend.

stages.title: Render answer
stages.description: Render the answer, latency, health and warnings directly in the MMIR chat UI.

stages.title: Compare and synthesize
stages.description: Run multiple model answers through comparison and synthesize the best result.
